title: Dragon Ball Super Just Got a Disappointing Sign for the Manga’s Return

title: Shonen Jump’s Latest Ending Manga Has the Most Unique Action Ending in History
content: The fifth major Shonen Jump series likely to end this year is going out with the most unique action sequence ever. So far, four major shonen series have already come to an end, three of which are action-based. The majority of action series arguably conclude in the same way.

title: Crunchyroll Adds Gunma-chan Anime's English Dub

title: We Are Aliens Film Wins Award at Hawai'i Int'l Film Festival
content: Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film won the Kau Ka Hōkū (Shooting Star) Award at the 46th Hawai'i International Film Festival in Waikiki on Sunday. The award honors an international filmmaker's first or second feature.
